do.name: Grube Samson silver mine tour
do.detail: A silver mine worked from the 16th century, and the one place left in the world with a working Fahrkunst, the oscillating ladder that carried miners down the shaft.

do.name: Skiing at Matthias-Schmidt-Berg and Sonnenberg
do.detail: Two small alpine areas with chairlifts, T-bars and runs of mixed difficulty, plus snow tubing and floodlit sledging in Teichtal.

do.name: Hiking in Nationalpark Harz
do.detail: Marked trails leave straight from the village to the Dreibrodesteine boulders and Oderteich, and the Harzer Hexenstieg passes through.

do.name: Cross-country skiing on the Harz loipe network
do.detail: Around 40 km of groomed loipen fan out from town, linking Waage, Oderberg and Beerberg circuits through the high Harz.

do.name: Sommerrodelbahn summer toboggan
do.detail: A 550 m summer toboggan run on the Matthias-Schmidt-Berg, reached by chairlift for repeat descents.

do.name: Mountain biking the Harz trails
do.detail: A small bike park with six graded trails plus marked cross-country routes through the surrounding national park forest.

do.name: Hochseilgarten ropes course
do.detail: Over 120 obstacles at varying heights, among the largest ropes courses in Germany.

do.name: Harzer Roller canary museum
do.detail: A small museum at the Samson mine on the singing canaries miners once bred and carried underground as gas detectors.
